description: Structured eval definitions for the Transfer Family Workflow Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Transfer Family scenarios (SFTP service-managed PUBLIC, SFTP custom Lambda VPC_ENDPOINT, managed workflow for file processing, AS2 connector for trading partner, missing IAM role prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: SFTP server with service-managed auth and PUBLIC endpoint
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SFTP, service-managed IDP, PUBLIC endpoint, per-user session policy, custom host key
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Transfer Family SFTP server in us-east-1 for B2B partner file exchange. Protocol: SFTP. Endpoint type: PUBLIC. Identity provider: service-managed. S3 bucket: partner-exchange. Users: partner-a and partner-b, each with LOGICAL home directory mapping to /partner-exchange/home/<user>. IAM role: TransferFamilyS3Access with trust policy for transfer.amazonaws.com. Session policy per user scoped to /partner-exchange/home/<user>/*. Server host key: custom RSA. Tags: Environment=production, App=partner-exchange.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TRANSFER_FAMILY: s-xxx (SFTP) — PUBLIC
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Server: s-xxx (SFTP)
  [✓] Endpoint type: PUBLIC
  [✓] Identity provider: Service-managed
  [✓] Session policy: attached per-user (scoped to /partner-exchange/home/<user>/*)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws transfer describe-server --server-id s-xxx
  aws transfer list-users --server-id s-xxx

eval_cases.name: SFTP server with custom Lambda IDP and VPC_ENDPOINT
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — VPC_ENDPOINT, custom Lambda IDP, PrivateLink, session policy, structured logging
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Transfer Family SFTP server in us-east-1 for internal file transfers. Protocol: SFTP. Endpoint type: VPC_ENDPOINT. VPC vpc-aaa11122, subnets subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb, security group sg-sftp-internal. Identity provider: custom Lambda function transfer-idp-auth. S3 bucket: file-landing-zone. Users provisioned dynamically by Lambda with LOGICAL home directory mapping. IAM role: TransferFamilyS3Access. Session policy: per-user scoped to /file-landing-zone/home/<user>/*. Structured JSON logging to CloudWatch Logs /aws/transfer/sftp. Tags: Environment=production, App=file-landing-zone.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TRANSFER_FAMILY: s-xxx (SFTP) — VPC_ENDPOINT
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Endpoint type: VPC_ENDPOINT (PrivateLink)
  [✓] Identity provider: Custom Lambda (transfer-idp-auth)
  [✓] VPC: vpc-aaa11122 (subnets: subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb)
  [✓] Session policy: attached per-user (S3 scoped)

eval_cases.name: Managed workflow for automated file processing
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — managed workflow with COPY, TAG, CUSTOM Lambda steps, on-exception steps
eval_cases.prompt: Create a managed workflow for Transfer Family server s-abc123 in us-east-1. The workflow should process incoming files: Step 1: COPY from /file-landing-zone/incoming/ to /processed-data/landing/. Step 2: TAG with Status=Processed. Step 3: CUSTOM Lambda virus-scan-file. On-exception: TAG with Status=Failed and send SNS notification. Attach the workflow to server s-abc123. S3 bucket: file-landing-zone.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TRANSFER_FAMILY: s-abc123 (workflow w-def456)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Managed workflow: w-def456 (COPY → TAG → CUSTOM Lambda scan)
  [✓] On-exception: TAG Status=Failed, SNS notification
  [✓] Workflow attached to server: s-abc123

eval_cases.name: AS2 connector for B2B trading partner file exchange
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — AS2 connector, local/partner profiles, certificate exchange, MDN SYNC
eval_cases.prompt: Create an AS2 connector for trading partner Acme Corp in us-east-1. Partner AS2 URL: https://as2.acme.com. Local AS2 profile: local-profile-xxx. Partner AS2 profile: partner-profile-yyy. Compression: ZLIB. Encryption: AES256_CBC. Signing: SHA256. MDN response: SYNC. MDN signing: SHA256. Trading partner certificate verified. Tags: Partner=acme, Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TRANSFER_FAMILY: AS2 connector c-xxx (Acme Corp)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] AS2 connector: c-xxx (partner: Acme Corp)
  [✓] Local profile: local-profile-xxx
  [✓] Partner profile: partner-profile-yyy
  [✓] Certificate: verified (partner public cert)

eval_cases.name: SFTP server without IAM role for S3 access (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — IAM role TransferFamilyS3Access does not exist; users cannot access S3
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Transfer Family SFTP server in us-east-1. Protocol: SFTP. Endpoint type: PUBLIC. Identity provider: service-managed. S3 bucket: file-exchange. The IAM role TransferFamilyS3Access does not exist yet. Users: partner-a with home directory /file-exchange/home/partner-a.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TRANSFER_FAMILY: SFTP server (pending)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] IAM role: TransferFamilyS3Access — MISSING; without it, users cannot access S3
